chunks: And within it is a river from Paradise into which the deeds of the servants are cast.

key_terms.أَعْمَالُ: the deeds or actions performed by human beings
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the heavenly abode from which this river is said to come
key_terms.الْعِبَادِ: the servants, meaning the worshippers or human servants of Allah
key_terms.نَهَرٌ: a river, described here as originating from Paradise
key_terms.يُلْقَى: is cast or placed, referring here to the deeds being put into it

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by a river from Paradise into which the deeds of the servants are cast?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sanctified reality connected to a place of worship, stating that within it is a river from Paradise into which the deeds of the servants are cast. It conveys the exalted spiritual rank of that place and its connection to divine acceptance and the unseen.
